result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in every promotion listing and in the code lookup. The full suite passes offline (612 tests, including a new one for the description round-trip). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: the record has a `description` component after `category`. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new six-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing five-argument method is kept and delegates with no description, so the existing callers and tests are untouched.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and every promotion query selects and maps it. That covers the code lookup, active on a date, active in a region, by category, best for a category on a date, and unused in a period.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOfPromotion` test covering the SUMMER case and a promotion created without one.

I did not change the demo data, so the demo promotions still have no description. I also did not add a way to set a description on a promotion after creation, since the task only asked for it at setup.
